scope: Discovery only: exact Fraction cost scores at the PR46 bit saving. Floating-point matching optimization proposes pinned candidates; full replay certifies the selected network. No optimality claim.
score_definition: R*(U(h)+U(m-2*h)-m) + sum_t copied_block_count[t]*U(t), where U(t) is the exact upper enclosure of t*exp(a*log(m/t)). Each axis contribution is multiplied by N/binomial(h,3) in the full cost.
